stages.title: DETERMINISM VERSUS POSSIBILISM

pills.text: FERTILE SOIL, IRON, RIVER OR MONSOON AUTOMATICALLY PRODUCES A
SIMILAR ENVIRONMENTS YIELD DIFFERENT TIMINGS AND INSTITUTIONS.
ECOLOGY OFFERS CONSTRAINTS, OPPORTUNITIES AND RECURRING RISKS.

sequence: DETERMINIST CLAIM: fertile soil, iron, river or monsoon automatically produces a state.
EVIDENCE AGAINST: similar environments yield different timings and institutions.
POSSIBILIST CORRECTION: ecology offers constraints, opportunities and recurring risks.
MEDIATORS: technology + labour + property + exchange + political organisation + culture
VERDICT: explain why an opportunity was mobilised, by whom, and with what limits.
